messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: autopager triggered for host gpu-node-17 (rack-c2). alert: kernel panic + kubelet not ready. PD key: PD-98321.
pagerduty: Paging oncall: alice_oncall (primary). page fired 1m ago.
alice_oncall: ackd. I'll grab serialconsole + check kubelet logs.
ben_infra: noted - looks like node dropped heartbeats and kubelet restarted twice in last 2m. I'm pulling dmesg now.
alice_oncall: logs from serial: `Kernel panic - not syncing: mmap_corruption detected (gpu-driver)`
carla_sre: yikes. any customer impact? routing shim should remove node automatically but checking active sessions.
ben_infra: `kubectl get pods -A --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-node-17` shows 6 tenant pods (inference) still Pending/Terminating. eviction not completed.
alice_oncall: running `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` now. output: 
```
error: unable to drain node "gpu-node-17"
found pod(s) not managed by a controller: tenant-a-worker-7, tenant-b-batch-3
```
ben_infra: those are long-running user jobs. we should try graceful eviction first, but kernel panic means node unstable. I'll start preemptive RMA ticket and mark as unschedulable.

mike_platform: tagging rack-c2 as maybe power-cycling; power distribution logs show a transient undervolt at 12:17:02. correlates with panic. Could be bad PSU on host. Opening infra incident (infra-412).

alice_oncall: customer-impact check: telemetry shows 0.7% tail-latency spike for the model-serving pool in region-us-west, some inference requests errored with 503 for ~90s. informing CS.

carla_sre: posting status: "Partial degradation: transient 503s for model-serving US-WEST; affected customers on Dedicated pools may see retries." cc @support-team :pray:.

ben_infra: attempted to force-evict pods via `kubectl delete pod tenant-a-worker-7 --grace-period=0 --force` — pod remains Terminating, kubelet unresponsive.
alice_oncall: switching to host-level cleanup. attaching to BMC/serial to power cycle. mike_platform do we have IPMI creds?
mike_platform: yes, executing IPMI cycle now: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.2.3.117 -U admin power cycle` -> success. host rebooting.

incident-bot: Node state changed: gpu-node-17 -> rebooting (serial attached).

carla_sre: good. continue monitoring. any sign of NVMe or GPU firmware corruption?

ben_infra: dmesg excerpt after reboot attempt (from serial buffer):
```
[12:17:02] nvidia: gpu0: Xid 79: GPU hang detected - mmap_corruption
[12:17:02] kernel: kernel panic - fatal exception
[12:17:04] kernel: Automatic sysrq triggered
```

alice_oncall: okay RMA plus kernel debug. tagging research for core dump retrieval. `echo 1 > /proc/sys/kernel/sysrq` and saving netconsole logs to s3://redwood-debug/gpu-node-17/1735554321/

mike_platform: power cycle completed, host came back to PXE, grub load started. kubelet still not registering.

alice_oncall: kubelet log shows immediate OOM killer + repeated restarts of `nv_driver` module. suspect driver/vbios mismatch after recent firmware push to rack-c2 (yesterday).

ben_infra: rollback plan: if node rejoins but drivers flapping, mark node unschedulable until we apply known-good firmware. pushing new cluster-safe label `firmware-pending` to rack-c2 hosts.

carla_sre: can we confirm customer traffic now stable? metrics show error rate back to baseline ~3m after the reboot. I'll update status to "mitigated - auto failover succeeded" and note ongoing host investigation.

alice_oncall: handing off to ben_infra for RMA + firmware rollback. I'll remain reachable for 30m in case the kubelet flaps again. //oncall-handoff @ben_infra :raising_hand:

ben_infra: taking over. I'll coordinate with infra on RMA and firmware rollback. opening follow-up thread and will attach full sysdump.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation policy advanced to secondary oncall after 2 acks.

pagerduty: incident PD-98321 moved to state acknowledged -> monitored.

carla_sre: thanks team. create postmortem placeholder with timeline + customer impact (503s to model-serving US-WEST). assigning owners: infra=ben_infra, oncall=alice_oncall, SRE=carla_sre.

alice_oncall: quick note: ran `kubectl rollout restart ds/gpu-drivers -n kube-system` across rack-c2 in staging yesterday; want to validate no cross-drift to prod. mention in postmortem.

ben_infra: RMA ticket filed (RMA-7891), vendor on call. ETA 72h for replacement; in the meantime we'll cordon host permanently and migrate tenants.

carla_sre: closing this thread; will reopen if kubelet regresses. :thumbsup:

alice_oncall: :white_check_mark: documented actions in incident doc and added kubelet+dmesg snippets to debug bucket.

pagerduty: PD-98321 resolved -> monitoring after 1h.

incident-bot: thread auto-archived after last message
